title: 318 Canal Street | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: 318 Canal Street is a 5.00 bedroom, 5.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 318 Canal Street is a modern and charming home on Canal Street, just outside of Seaside. With 3291 sq ft, 5 beds and 5.5 baths, this retreat offers luxury, comfort, and privacy. Enjoy the huge kitchen with an island and living space that looks out at natural Florida landscape to the canal, magnolias, oaks, and private pool.With one Master Suite on the first floor, and another on the second, the upstairs Main Master provides a spacious bathroom with separate tub and shower peering out to the treetops and private back deck over looking the pool. The pool can be heated during winter months for an additional fee. Large walk-in closet and is also equipped with a coffee bar for mornings on the back porch. This modern retreat offers incredible proximity to Seaside and the beach, all within the sanctuary of Old Seagrove.Sleeping Arrangements - Sleeps 13:Bedroom 1: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with walk-in shower.Bedroom 2: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with tub and large walk-in shower.Bedroom 3: 2 sets of twin-over-twin bunk beds, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.Bedroom 4: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.Bedroom 5: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with walk-in shower.1 twin futon mattress.Your stay at 318 Canal Street comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Pool heat can be added for an additional fee* Parking for 3-4 cars in driveway* Sorry, no pets allowedA Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
